_about: Everything Tesserae and Tesserae Cloud ship or build on that someone else made. The single source for docs/credits.md (scripts/gen_credits.py) and the cloud's Credits page (tools/gen_credits.mjs). Fonts are read from each font file's own copyright metadata; tests fail when a bundled font or vendored library has no entry.
